P, K = map(int, input().split())
used = [False] * 1000000
MOD = 10**9 + 7

def dfs(curr):
    if used[curr]:
        return
    used[curr] = True
    dfs((curr * K) % P)

ans = 1
if K == 1:
    ans = (ans * P) % MOD

for i in range(1, P):
    if not used[i]:
        dfs(i)
        ans = (ans * P) % MOD

print(ans)
</translated_code>
